player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in Nim.
Your goal is to take the last remaining object.
On each turn, choose exactly one pile and remove one or more objects from it.
Use the format '[pile quantity]', where pile is the pile index and quantity is the number of objects to remove.
For example, '[0 3]' removes 3 objects from pile 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tewali kika kya kutambuza kituufu kizuuliddwa. Kozesa '[pile quantity]'.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Mchezaji {player_id}, kikao si sahihi. Safu {col} si mu mipaka.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ekitebe kya Pile {pile_index} kiri ebweru w'ebbanga.

observation.removed_from_piles: Mchezaji {player_id} alizanya [{pile_index} {quantity}], akiva {quantity} kintu (ki) mu kikundi {pile_index}.
